_approach: Dariacore has been called 'pop music on steroids' and 'controlled chaos' — an amalgamation of deconstructed pop/dance elements rather than a single clean genre skeleton (Wikipedia). This groove is the maximalist construction approach itself: hardstyle kick, breakbeat snare, complextro hi-hat stutter, a tom fill and a cowbell accent all running at once, every role near-full most of the time — deliberately over-stuffed rather than balanced, the opposite construction principle from every sparser groove above. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
